content.title: It’s April Fools’ Day! And No One Will Ever See These Pranks Coming
content.text: Ree Drummond1‘Pay’ to Put Air in TiresRee recently pulled a popular TikTok prank on Ladd by claiming she paid $200 for ‘premium air’ in a low tire. He was stunned! She doubled down, insisting that she was told premium air was the best air. She says, “The funniest part was toward the end when he said, ‘Honey! There's no such thing as premium air! Air is free!’Caitlin Bensel2Bake 'Cinnamon' RollsSpoiler alert: There is definitely no cinnamon in this recipe. While everyone will expect a sweet treat, they're actually filled with pulled pork and barbecue sauce. So while tasty, they're certainly not something they'll expect for breakfast or dessert.Get the April Fools' 'Cinnamon Rolls' recipe.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowAlex Drummond3‘Break’ the TV ScreenTake a cue from Alex with this hilarious prank. “Okay but I found this YouTube broken screen video and got Mauricio pretty good,” she posted last year. She adds, “I told him I accidentally threw George’s toy at it. He was so upset haha.”Organic Media//Getty Images4Cover Sensors on Remote ControlsPlacing a tiny piece of tape over the TV remote’s sensor can turn into a surprisingly funny April Fools’ prank. Watching someone mash the buttons, aim the remote from every angle, and wonder why the TV has suddenly betrayed them is all part of the fun.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowMichelle Lee Photography//Getty Images5Color Your MilkMulticolored milk? No, thanks! Add a few drops of food coloring to your milk container and watch everyone's shock when they go to pour it. The same could be done with the creamer at the office!Jamie Grill//Getty Images6Swap the CerealsHere’s a simple yet satisfactory switch-up! Replace the contents of a familiar cereal box with a completely different kind and serve breakfast as usual. You’re sure to get a few double takes if you swap something like sugary loops for bran flakes.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowImage Source//Getty Images7Swap Out Family PhotosSee how observant your family is by swapping out one or more of your family photos and see who notices. You can either superimpose a celebrity into an existing photo or simply use the display picture that often comes with a store-bought frame.Jessica Shaver Photography//Getty Images8Hide All the UtensilsBefore everyone wakes up or maybe before dinner, hide all of your forks and spoons and see the surprise on everyone's faces when they go to grab the essentials and find them all gone!Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowRee Drummond9Hide Fake SnakesYou think this list wouldn't include the classic Drummond prank? It's hiss-terical. Simply buy a rubber snake and hide it in a spot you know they'll end up like in bed, in the shower, or in the silverware drawer.Karl Tapales//Getty Images10Make 'Chocolate Chip' CookiesMake some chocolate chip cookies but swap out the chips for raisins. One bite and they'll taste the difference immediately! If you want to really mix them up, bake some with chocolate chips, too, so they don't know which ones are which.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowOleg Begunenco / 500px//Getty Images11Turn Jell-O into JuiceYou can prank the kids at breakfast by swapping out their orange juice for orange Jell-O. They'll get quite a shock when they go to sip it.Amazon12Plant a Fake $100 BillTuck a fake $100 bill in an easy-to-see spot. Just when they think of their good fortune, they'll pull it out to see the other side laughing at them. You can buy fake bills or print out your own!Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowCarlina Teteris//Getty Images13Freeze BreakfastOn March 31, pour bowls of cereal and milk and stick them in the freezer. In the morning, serve them to your kids and watch their faces as they can't get anything on their spoons!Westend61//Getty Images14Flip Someone's Computer ScreenIf your family or coworkers use a PC with a Windows operating system, you can flip the display screen upside down by pressing CTRL, ALT, and the downward arrow key. (Don't worry, it's easily reversible by pressing CTRL, ALT, and the upward arrow key!)Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowPaula Daniëlse//Getty Images15Give the House Some EyesWho doesn't find googly eyes hilarious? Pick something visible, say your houseplants or maybe everything in your fridge and decorate them with googly eyes. Everyone will crack up!Image Professionals GmbH//Getty Images16Swap Everyone's LaundrySwitch out the contents of everyone's sock or underwear drawer and watch them scramble to get dressed! Eventually, they'll all realize they have the same problem and figure it out.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowChadchai Ra-ngubpai//Getty Images17Confuse Your Favorite Chat BuddyDownload a GIF of the anticipatory "typing dots" message indicator and send it to your favorite unsuspecting chat buddy. They'll think you're about to send a message all day long!Imgorthand//Getty Images18Move the Clocks ForwardIf you have alarm or wall clocks in the house, move them all an hour or two ahead! That goes for the clocks on the microwave and all other appliances, so they're all consistent.Advertisement - Continue Reading BelowThinkstock Images//Getty Images19Scare Them in the ShowerAdd a cardboard life-size cutout or wall decal of someone in shower and hear them screech when they open the shower curtain!Anthony Bradshaw//Getty Images20Serve Veggies for DessertDid you know that if you dip Brussels sprouts in chocolate and let them dry, they look like chocolate truffles? Better yet, if you add a lollipop stick, they look like cake pops.AnnMarie Mattila is the Senior Editor for The Pioneer Woman, covering a wide range of topics from food and cooking to home, beauty, style, and more.This content is imported from OpenWeb.
